name: Humanitarian funding gap
summary: WFP cuts Gaza food aid for 500,000 people over a $450m gap; Somalia and Sudan aid also squeezed
state: WFP is dropping about 500,000 people in Gaza from food aid as a funding gap of about $450m deepens (Outlook India; DevelopmentAid). More than 700,000 people in Somalia lose WFP food assistance in November (Eastleigh Voice). No formal suspension of food or health aid in a famine-risk country had been announced as of 7 Nov.
for_you: No direct risk to most readers; the UN's funding appeals are listed by OCHA.
rubric_hit: Major ration cuts announced = Watch; no pipeline break in famine-risk country (Alert)

sources.title: DevelopmentAid — Funding cuts force WFP to scale back food aid in Gaza
Eastleigh Voice — Over 700,000 Somalis to lose food assistance in November

why: When appeals go unfunded, food aid and health services are cut first; funding gaps lead famine and displacement by months.
drivers: Donor budgets and aid cuts, new crises competing for funds, access constraints.

rubric.alert: Pipeline breaks forcing large-scale suspension of food or health aid in famine-risk countries.
rubric.watch: Funding more than 10 percentage points behind recent years at the same point, or major ration cuts announced.
rubric.normal: UN global appeal funding in line with recent years; no major ration cuts.
